ExperimentSnapshot.title: ExperimentSnapshot
ExperimentSnapshot.description: A saved parameter state and telemetry readout from the interactive silicon, thermodynamic, or biophysical simulation sandbox.

ownerId.description: The authenticated user UID who created the snapshot.

title.description: Human-readable title of the saved simulation state.

moduleType.description: Which simulation module generated this snapshot.

parameters.description: Map of simulation numeric and boolean parameters.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the experiment snapshot.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the snapshot was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the snapshot was last updated.

ResearchNote.title: ResearchNote
ResearchNote.description: A synthesized research note or Gemini intelligence critique saved by a user.

ownerId.description: The authenticated user UID who owns this note.

modelUsed.description: Gemini model tier used to synthesize the note.

content.description: Markdown or plain text body of the research analysis.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was last updated.

ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: A saved multi-turn Gemini research conversation thread.

ownerId.description: The authenticated user UID who owns this chat session.

lastMessagePreview.description: Preview snippet of the latest response.

messageCount.description: Total number of messages in the session (1 to 100).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was last updated.

/experiments/{experimentId}.description: Stores user-saved simulation snapshots from the interactive sandbox.

/notes/{noteId}.description: Stores user-saved Gemini intelligence syntheses and research annotations.

/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores metadata and summaries of multi-turn Gemini research conversations.
